items.html: It emerges from this that the three hundred fifteen sparks are in the seven kings of the phase of ZA, and another three hundred fifteen are in the seven kings included in the Nukva. In these three hundred fifteen there are phases of lights, sparks, and vessels, and these gather in the bowels of Ima, to be corrected by the drop of Mayin Nukvin, the Mem-Nun-Tzadi-Peh-Chaf of Ima. For although they are Gevurot, they are sweetened and made pleasant, these three hundred fifteen sparks mentioned. So too are they sweetened by the five Hassadim of Aba, the drop of Mayin Duchrin.
